stylePreamble: An ultra-detailed cinematic miniature diorama belonging to one continuous dreamlike Pocket Worlds landscape. Handcrafted architectural scale-model realism with organic terrain, realistic water, refined vegetation, tactile natural materials, premium tilt-shift depth, soft atmospheric perspective, warm sunlight diffused through pale ivory mist, delicate clouds, soft long shadows, editorial photography quality, poetic and believable rather than toy-like. Cohesive palette of warm ivory #F5F0E6, mist blue #BCD6E7, ocean teal #4F9EA8, leaf green #4F6F45, temple terracotta #9A553C, charcoal #192432, and captured-light gold #FFD58A. No text, no letters, no captions, no logos, no picture frames, no floating photo billboards, no generic low-poly clay look, no glossy plastic toy look, no neon science-fiction styling.

worlds.label: Wander
worlds.subject: A full-frame miniature coastline occupying most of the view: shallow moving waves, a tactile beach and rock edge, elevated green terrain, one dramatic cliff and waterfall, scattered refined vegetation, distant atmospheric hills, layered pale clouds, and one restrained aircraft far above. A thread of captured sunlight begins in the ivory mist, sweeps along the coast, climbs the terrain, passes the waterfall, and leaves toward the next world. Wide elevated three-quarter composition, focal coastline and waterfall held in the centre-safe area, rich foreground and midground depth, no empty studio background.
worlds.focalPoint: the meeting point of the coastline, cliff path, and waterfall
worlds.diveMotion: Begin high in pale atmospheric mist with the miniature coast already filling the frame. Glide forward and descend along the shoreline, skim above shallow waves, then rise gently beside the cliff and waterfall. Follow the captured-light path as it curls through trees. End by settling into a slow upward-and-forward drift toward an opening in the clouds leading to Sacred Geometry.
worlds.connectorMotion: Pull up through the coastal mist without reversing abruptly, follow the captured-light thread across one connected miniature landscape, and let the terrain become increasingly ordered and symmetrical. Arrive above monumental temple platforms and begin a calm descent toward the central tower.

worlds.label: Sacred Geometry
worlds.subject: A monumental miniature temple environment filling the frame, with tower forms rising through layered stone and terracotta platforms beneath a large textured sky. Repeating carved geometry, a restrained festival route, small cloth flags moving in warm air, and the suggestion of a chariot path are integrated into the terrain. The captured-light thread becomes ordered and architectural, tracing steps, platforms, and vertical alignments before leaving through a high opening. Centre-safe primary tower, rich foreground masonry, no generic mandalas or invented religious symbols.
worlds.focalPoint: the carved central tower and the illuminated path climbing its layered platform
worlds.diveMotion: Begin above the complete temple landscape. Descend in a controlled crane-like glide while making a restrained half orbit around the central tower, revealing carved tiers and the festival path in parallax. Follow the captured-light line upward through repeating geometry. End in a slow forward drift toward one jewel-like reflection set into the architecture, the transition point to Small Wonders.
worlds.connectorMotion: Move forward into the jewel-like highlight without a cut. The captured-light thread refracts through it as monumental geometry changes scale and becomes the veins of a giant dew-covered leaf. Arrive inside a luminous macro garden and settle into a gentle descent toward a central droplet.

worlds.label: Small Wonders
worlds.subject: A full-frame macro miniature garden where one giant rain-covered leaf forms the terrain, oversized clear droplets become pools and lenses, slender yellow flowers rise like architecture, small rain ripples animate shaded hollows, and warm tomato-red observations appear as restrained accents. The captured-light thread refracts naturally through droplets and continues through the garden. Luminous greens and yellows, shallow depth changes, tactile wet surfaces, centre-safe leaf and primary droplet, no full-frame distortion or shader-demo look.
worlds.focalPoint: the largest clear droplet resting on the leaf terrain among yellow flowers
worlds.diveMotion: Begin above the entire leaf landscape, then push close to the central droplet until refraction reveals the garden at another scale. Ease back into a low forward track between flower forms with foreground droplets sliding past in parallax. End by settling into a slow forward drift through a shaded opening in layered foliage toward Living Things.
worlds.connectorMotion: Follow the captured-light thread through the droplet and into deep layered foliage. The macro leaf terrain becomes a hidden canopy without a cut. Glide forward through shafts of filtered light and arrive in a quiet clearing where a restrained parakeet presence can be discovered naturally.

worlds.label: Living Things
worlds.subject: A richly layered miniature hidden canopy filling the frame, with deep natural greens, tactile foliage, small clearings, filtered shafts of warm light, and a calm centre-safe parakeet inspired by the source photograph. A sheltered warm nook quietly recalls the resting cat, while distant open terrain beyond the trees recalls grazing cattle. Animal presence is restrained and believable; environmental movement carries the scene. The captured-light thread passes through leaves and clearings before warming toward the final world. No cartoon animals, no exaggerated motion.
worlds.focalPoint: the quiet parakeet reveal in a shaft of filtered light at the centre of the canopy
worlds.diveMotion: Glide beneath the canopy at a respectful distance, using foliage occlusion and slow foreground parallax to reveal the parakeet. Hold the animal nearly still with only natural breathing or a slight head movement while light and leaves move around it. Continue past the clearing toward a warmer sheltered opening, ending in a slow forward drift toward Table Notes.
worlds.connectorMotion: Follow the captured-light thread out of the shaded canopy as deep greens become banana-leaf ground planes. The path warms from pale gold to toasted gold, circles ceramic surfaces, and arrives above an intimate table-like gathering space without becoming a commercial food advertisement.

worlds.label: Table Notes
worlds.subject: A warm full-frame miniature gathering space arranged in a calm circular table composition. Banana-leaf-inspired ground planes, handmade ceramic and clay surfaces, restrained steam, tactile shadows, spice red, leaf green, and toasted-gold accents create an intimate observational world. Small plated details are integrated as terrain and architecture rather than product display. The captured-light path circles the table, gathers every previous colour, and converges into a luminous contact-sheet or archive-grid motif at the end. Centre-safe circular focal composition, no restaurant-ad styling.
worlds.focalPoint: the circular banana-leaf gathering where the captured-light thread converges
worlds.diveMotion: Descend into the circular gathering, make a slow half orbit around the tactile food-and-ceramic landscape, push close to one steam-lit craft detail, then ease back. Follow the captured-light thread as it completes the circle and gathers into an elegant archive-grid motif. End in a composed, nearly still forward drift suitable for the final Index call to action.
